summary: Source Workbench result history validates complete lists, preserves verified records, selection and unsaved editing on failed or recovered reads, and separates pending/unavailable from authoritative empty history. Only the latest request publishes data or recovery feedback; unrelated warnings remain. Results refresh, runtime Retry All and PWDT recovery are read-only. Confirmed save/delete remains separate from failed follow-up reads, and deletion removes only its local record. Sixteen actual Chromium controls use isolated mocked services; twenty-eight added unit controls cover result envelopes, failure and ownership. This is not installed, remote, scale, solver correctness or ambiguous-write reconciliation evidence.

required_text: result recovery clears only its own channel
read recovery must not discard unsaved edits
runtime Retry All button really recovers results
cannot finish a newer pending read
read recovery must not replay failed writes
